_doc: Typical-investor gearing assumptions. 'rate' is filled from RBA F6 at build time. Edit here, rebuild, and the map/insights/calculator defaults all change.
lvr_note: 20% deposit / 80% LVR, the usual no-LMI ceiling. APRA Quarterly ADI Property Exposures, June 2026 (published 17 Sep 2026): 29.7% of new loans funded had LVR >= 80%, so most new loans sit at or below 80%.
repayment_note: Principal & interest, 30-year term (the conservative default; interest-only is selectable in the calculator).
mgmt_note: Property management ~7% of rent collected, incl. GST.

A._note: All dwellings: midpoint of house and unit costs

costs_note: Strata levies, council rates + water service charges and landlord/building insurance are flat state-wide assumptions, not postcode data. Check your actual levies and rates.

land_tax.note: NSW general threshold $1,075,000 (2026 land tax year, frozen since 2025): $100 + 1.6% of land value above it. Default $0 assumes a single investment property with land value under the threshold.

gearing_note: Gearing is judged on the tax result: rent received minus deductible costs and loan interest (principal repayments are not deductible). Positive if > +$20/wk, negative if < -$20/wk, otherwise neutral. Cash flow additionally subtracts principal repayments.
tax_note: 2026-27 resident marginal rates (15% bracket from 1 Jul 2026) plus 2% Medicare levy. Estimate only.
